The goal of this vignette is to give some examples of how to benchmark the C++ code.

```{r}
result_list <- atime::atime(
  setup={
    N_list <- Poncatime:::generate_data_interface(N, N*100, 10)
  },
  result=TRUE,
  asoCurvatureEstimation=with(N_list, data.frame(count=Poncatime:::asoCurvatureEstimation_interface(pointVec, queriesVec, 1)))
)
plot(result_list)

ref_list <- atime::references_best(result_list)
plot(ref_list)

pred_list <- predict(ref_list)
plot(pred_list)
```
